recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-9582 unless a future work group decision reactivates ProcessRequest or recreates the retired examples.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive FM issue reported that the ProcessRequest scope text told implementers to poll for payment reconciliations with include value PaymentReconciliation while the JSON/XML examples still used Reconciliation. The recorded Jira resolution says it was addressed in STU3.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-9582 was found. Git commit 8bb18c94b2070f7234919f5a8adaec778bdc6b9b changed source/processrequest/processrequest-example-poll-payrec.xml from include value Reconciliation to include value PaymentReconciliation in October 2016, matching the requested correction.
additional_context: Current source/processrequest/processrequest-introduction.xml still describes the poll use case with PaymentReconciliation, and source/processrequest/processrequest-example-poll-payrec.xml uses include value PaymentReconciliation. source/fhir.ini comments out processrequest as an active resource and notes ProcessRequest is approved but should use Task; commit 642e610a19880384fa234022f0166a3111678708 made that deactivation. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change is needed because the requested example correction is already present, no stale Reconciliation include remains under source/, and ProcessRequest is outside the active current build.
